title: tanacetum aureum var. oligocephalum
intro: Tanacetum aureum var. oligocephalum, commonly known as Golden Tansy, is a plant species in the daisy family that is native to New Zealand. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation, and has been used to treat various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Golden Tansy are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as arthritis and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, such as dihydrocostuslactone, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
